name: qa6-live-harness
_note: Built from templates/live-harness.template.json. `observations` is the additive per-scenario key; tools/live_harness_runner.py carries it but does not evaluate it — every observation is asserted inside the pytest scenario the command runs.

reset.name: Sweep dead qa6 runs (only roots/sockets whose owning pid is dead)
reset.command: .venv/bin/python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'tests'); from qa6 import teardown; r = teardown.sweep_dead_runs(); sys.stdout.write(str(r) + chr(10)); sys.exit(1 if r.live_owners else 0)"
reset.expected: exit 0; a live owner is BLOCKED, never touched

seed.name: Seeds are minted per run by the runner (bootstrap.mint: shims, git fixtures) and per instance (seed_db)
seed.expected: no global seed exists: ephemeral everything (env-plan §5)

healthcheck.name: Harness guards (env-plan §4 step 1a)
healthcheck.expected: exit 0: wait helpers, publish gate, catalog, hygiene, and the five qa5-copy mutation proofs

scenarios.name: wave 1: S0, W1, W2, W3, W4, W5 (6 scenarios)
scenarios.given: preflight T1-T4 green, harness guards green, a fresh pid-scoped run root
scenarios.when: the runner runs wave 1's lanes in stopifs.WAVE_LANES order (one pytest process per lane, -p no:randomly)
scenarios.then: one record per scenario (PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED) with clauses and evidence; the report gate publishes GREEN only on 161 PASS
scenarios.expected: a report under .cc10x/qa/<wf>/runs/; exit 0 only if GREEN (a correct run of this build is RED: the plan predicts FAILs)
observations: W1 stdout start line while Popen alive; socket 0600/0700 under TMPDIR; /api/fleet ok; app_state.discovery_status.last_scan_at advances >=2.0s; runner_socket; schema 4; SSE ': open'
W2 ps eww env under run root, no TMUX/CLAUDE*; lsof open files never under real ~/.claude or real Shepherd data; real dirs == baseline
W3 one root visible; #stream-status 'live' (FAIL(bound) only with /api/events 200); 0 console errors; one EventSource
W4 'controld stopped: 4 threads exited · store closed'; exit 0; socket gone; PRAGMA integrity_check ok
W5 product read_pane: shim PROMPT_READY, bare cat UNREADABLE, dialog mode recorded
S0 LIVE_AUTH_MODE bound by the 3x3 table; real settings sha unchanged after every sub-probe

scenarios.name: full run: all nine waves in order, then teardown and the publish gate
scenarios.given: the host baseline matches setup.md (settings sha measured at run start and unchanged at every check; a run-start sha other than the owner-named f99112b6…c52b is a published non-stopping WARN, INC-3, accepted by the owner 2026-09-27; 8787 owned by WatchTower, no shq6 state)
scenarios.when: the runner runs every wave with its stop-ifs, then removes the run roots and leak-checks
scenarios.then: an immutable runs/<run_id>.json, report.md, and qa6-latest.json carrying the history
scenarios.expected: GREEN only on 161 PASS + every lane exit 0 + clean teardown; RED on any FAIL; INCOMPLETE otherwise
observations: runs/<run_id>.json status/reasons/counts
teardown-problems.jsonl empty
ledgers/tmux-argv.log Z2 shape

cleanup.name: Verify no qa6 state survives (roots, q6 tmux sockets, daemons)
cleanup.command: bash -c 'shopt -s nullglob; a=(/private/tmp/shq6-*); b=(/private/tmp/tmux-$(id -u)/shepherd-m3-q6*); echo roots=${#a[@]} sockets=${#b[@]}; test ${#a[@]} -eq 0 -a ${#b[@]} -eq 0'
cleanup.expected: roots=0 sockets=0 (the runner's own teardown removed them)
